children: GT Biopharma announced a private placement of Series M 10% Convertible Preferred Stock and warrants for $7.45 million in gross proceeds ($8.28 million stated value), featuring conversion at $6.10 and full ratchet protections. Purchasers received five-year warrants equal to 100% of the conversion shares and vesting warrants tied to greenshoe exercises; a $1.282 floor may apply if required by Nasdaq. The company also signed a Registration Rights Agreement with deadlines and liquidated damages, obtained insider voting commitments for required shareholder approvals, and executed insider lock-ups to support an orderly market.
